user.title: Choose setup mode
user.description: Pick how this integration should match Canal & River Trust notices.

gps.title: GPS proximity
gps.description: Track a device tracker and match published notices within a configurable radius. If the tracker is missing or unavailable, Home Assistant's configured home coordinates are used.

data_description.device_tracker_entity_id: Optional. Leave empty to always use Home Assistant home coordinates.
data_description.radius_miles: Only notices with geometry inside this radius are matched. Notices without geometry are still included.

manual.title: Manual canal selection
manual.description: Select one or more CRT waterways to monitor. Level-1 waterways are shown by default. If you enable all waterways, submit once to reload the expanded list.

data_description.show_all_waterways: Enable this to include branches and sub-branches in the selector.
data_description.waterways: Matches use case-insensitive substring checks against CRT's waterway text.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the CRT API.

abort.already_configured: This CRT notices source is already configured.

init.title: Canal and River Trust Notices options
init.description: Update notice filtering and refresh settings.

data_description.device_tracker_entity_id: Optional. Leave empty to use Home Assistant home coordinates.
data_description.show_all_waterways: Enable this to include branches and sub-branches in the selector.
data_description.lookahead_days: How many days ahead to request from the CRT API.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often the integration refreshes published notices.
